name: delinea
description: Work with Delinea Secret Server and the Delinea Platform from Claude: find and use secrets without exposing passwords, run SQL reports, and manage folders, users, groups, roles and access requests.

delinea_base_url.title: Secret Server URL
delinea_base_url.description: Base URL of your Secret Server, e.g. https://example.secretservercloud.com (Secret Server Cloud) or https://ss.example.com/SecretServer (on-premises).

delinea_username.title: Username
delinea_username.description: Secret Server account the plugin signs in as. Use a dedicated Application Account: Secret Server 12.1+ blocks password sign-in for regular users by default. When a Platform hostname is set, this is the Platform service account (client ID) used to reach Secret Server.

delinea_password.title: Password
delinea_password.description: Password (or Platform client secret) for the account above. Stored in your operating system's secure credential store.

platform_hostname.title: Delinea Platform hostname (optional)
platform_hostname.description: Your Delinea Platform tenant, e.g. example.delinea.app. Leave empty for a standalone Secret Server.

platform_service_account.title: Platform service account (optional)
platform_service_account.description: Platform service account used by the Platform user and role tools. Leave empty if you don't use them.

platform_service_password.title: Platform service account password (optional)
platform_service_password.description: Password for the Platform service account. Stored in your operating system's secure credential store.

platform_tenant_id.title: Platform tenant ID (optional)
platform_tenant_id.description: Only needed when your Platform administrator gave you a secondary tenant ID.

allow_plaintext_reveal.title: Allow revealing passwords
allow_plaintext_reveal.description: Off by default. When on, Claude can show a masked password or key in plaintext, but only after you approve a prompt each time. Credentials can always be used without being shown.

enabled_tools.title: Enabled tools (optional)
enabled_tools.description: Leave blank to enable every tool. To limit what Claude can do, enter comma-separated tool names, for example get_secret,search_secrets,get_secret_environment_variable.
